Name: DANGBI's Pierre for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9357]this Pierre portrait[/url] by DAGBI in the depths of the site and I really liked it! Perms are open for it as well as Seasonal Cute's Pierre assets so I combined them for a fresh new look for Pierre! 

This mod is meant to be used with Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]. Simply overwrite the portrait and character assets with the ones downloaded here.

Enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Just drag and drop over the original seasonal cute and let overwrite
